Choosing a career is more than choosing a job title. It is understanding your strengths, exploring your options, and knowing what to work on next. That is the purpose behind Edu2career.

Our approach

Start with who you are.
Build toward where you want to go.

Our vision puts your profile at the centre of career exploration, helping you understand your options and plan your next step.

Planned product experience

Guidance that connects
your profile to a plan.

We are developing a profile-based platform to make career exploration more personal and preparation more practical.

Explore

Career-path suggestions

Explore roles connected to your education, skills, and interests, and understand the reasoning behind each suggestion.

Understand

Skill-gap guidance

Compare your current profile with the skills associated with your target roles, so you can prioritise what to learn.

Build

Learning roadmaps

Turn a career goal into manageable steps, from learning topics to practical projects that demonstrate your ability.

Present

Résumé feedback

Present your real skills, projects, and experience clearly, with feedback that helps you improve your profile.

Practise

Interview preparation

Practise role-relevant questions and use feedback to make your answers clearer and better supported by experience.

Ask

A career conversation

Ask follow-up questions about career choices and preparation through the AI-assisted guidance we plan to build.

The features above describe our planned product experience. Contact the founder for current product status and availability. Recommendations are intended to support your choices; they do not guarantee employment.

The story behind Edu2career

An education should
open doors
and offer direction.

Edu2career started in October 2024 with a focus on students making the transition from educational institutions into the job market.

Our aim is to help students understand career options through their own profiles and turn that understanding into practical preparation.

A few useful answers

Before your
next step.

Who is Edu2career for?

Our intended users are students in educational institutions who want to explore career paths and prepare for the job market.

Can I use the platform today?

This website introduces our company and planned product experience. For the current product stage and availability, please contact the founder.

How would AI support career guidance?

We plan to use AI to help interpret student profiles, explain possible career paths, identify skill gaps, and support learning and interview preparation. We intend to ground this guidance in student-provided information and curated career resources.

Will Edu2career make career decisions for me?

No. The planned guidance is advisory. You retain control over which careers to explore, what to learn, and which opportunities to pursue.
